response:
I'm so sorry for the loss of your grandpa. Grief can feel overwhelming, and it makes sense that you're having a rough time—that pain reflects how much he meant to you.

There are free or low-cost options that can help. Many communities have grief support groups through hospices, which often offer bereavement services at no charge even if your grandpa wasn't in their care. Faith communities, community mental health centers, and colleges (if you're a student) may offer free counseling too. You can also call or text 988 (in the US) anytime to talk with someone if the pain feels like too much to carry alone. Online communities and grief support apps can offer connection as well.

Leaning on family or friends who knew him can also help—sharing memories often eases the weight a little. Be gentle with yourself; there's no timeline for grief. Would you like help finding resources in your area?
